title: 多益高頻商務片語與句型 - 第 3 輯
description: 精選聽力 Part 3/4 與閱讀 Part 5/6 常考關鍵片語與搭配句型。

words.definitionZh: （用餐後）結帳；支付帳單

visualAnchor.imagePrompt: Modern luxury hotel conference hall and banqueting venue, professional staff coordinating high-end catering and reception arrangements for incoming international corporate delegation, photorealistic, cinematic corporate lighting, 8k resolution, professional workplace photography
visualAnchor.scene: 商務飯店與會展宴會接待場地配合貴賓需求之專業場景

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries pick up the check before Friday's executive meeting.
examples.zh: 所有專案主管均被要求在週五高層會議之前，【結帳】提交每週進度摘要。

examples.en: Management confirmed that the new workplace safety policy will take effect pick up the check across all manufacturing plants.
examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【結帳】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

examples.en: Our corporation expanded its global distribution network pick up the check to satisfy rising international consumer demand.
examples.zh: 我司【結帳】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。

quizzes.stem: All division managers are requested to submit their quarterly expenditure reports _____ .
quizzes.stemTranslation: 請所有部門經理務必【結帳】提交季度支出報告。
quizzes.strategy: 分析句末副詞/介系詞片語位置，選入最切合商務作業規範之片語 pick up the check。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益常考商務固定片語搭配，切勿僅字面直翻。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「結帳」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: Strict compliance with established _____ is mandatory for all personnel operating heavy machinery.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 切實遵守既定的【結帳】，對於所有操作重型機具之人員皆屬強制規定。
quizzes.strategy: established 為形容詞，介系詞 with 之後需填入受詞名詞 pick up the check。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意介系詞後受詞之詞性要求與上下文語法結構。
collocations: in accordance with pick up the check

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】文法詞性完全符合空格之結構要求。
【干擾】此詞形在此處文法結構中不符。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'pick up the check' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「pick up the check」（【結帳】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，pick up the check（結帳）之核心涵義與 pick up the check 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。
collocations: pick up the check = pick up the check

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

📧 [INTERNAL MEMORANDUM]
To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

請確保我們部門採取一切必要措施，在日常營運中【結帳】既定的企業基準。
quizzes.strategy: 內部備忘錄公告提及 takes measures to _____（採取措施以...），填入 pick up the check 最切合商務政策語境。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 內部行政備忘錄常使用正式書面語體與政策規章搭配。
collocations: adhere to pick up the check

📩 [CLIENT CORRESPONDENCE]
To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📩【客戶商務信函】
收件人：全球採購合作夥伴
主旨：合作關係與服務確認

我們很高興地向您確認，我司能夠按既定時程【結帳】貴方未來的商務需求。

📢 [EXECUTIVE POLICY ANNOUNCEMENT]
To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

收件人：各分行總監

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries even now before Friday's executive meeting.
examples.zh: 所有專案主管均被要求在週五高層會議之前，【即使現在】提交每週進度摘要。

examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【即使現在】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

examples.zh: 我司【即使現在】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。
